environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes pod spec with securityContext.capabilities.drop containing CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. Additionally, the cluster runs Kyverno 1.11 with a ClusterPolicy 'restrict-capabilities' in enforce mode that validates all pods have these capabilities dropped. The OCI runtime spec (runc) enforces the capability bounding set at cgroup level. Note: the mass assignment vulnerability in UpdateProfile still allows setting is_admin=true and can_export=true via JSON binding, but the ExportData handler's ping command fails with EPERM (operation not permitted) when CAP_NET_RAW is absent, and /proc/net/tcp read returns connection-level data only (no privileged info) since CAP_SYS_ADMIN is dropped, causing the export endpoint to return 503.

kyverno_policy.name: restrict-capabilities
kyverno_policy.rule: validate that spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop contains NET_RAW and SYS_ADMIN
